column1: # --- 272D0: screen fade (Quest 64 US twin file: screen_dim.c)

column3: clears the fade flags D_8008CA50 and frame count D_8008CE58, fills D_8008CA58 with a 256-step 0xDC grey alpha ramp; called at the start of the Core_Run* loops

each field frame (Gfx_BuildFrameDisplayList): with D_8008CA50 bit 3 draws D_8004F550 (black fill rectangles over y 0..40 and 200..239, letterbox bars); with bit 0 draws the full-screen quad D_8004F510 in env colour *D_8008CE5C, then steps the ramp pointer (+1, -1 with flag 4) and counts D_8008CE58 down, clearing bit 0 at 0 unless flag 2; renamed from Fade_UpdateAndDraw because it also advances the fade
(frames, flags, ramp): D_8008CE58 = frames, D_8008CA50 = flags | 1 (keeping bit 3), D_8008CE5C = ramp; Fade_StartTransitionIn/Out, the inventory toggle and Enemy_CalcAttackDamage call it
(rom, ram, size): invalidates I/D cache, osPiStartDma in 0x4000-byte pieces on D_8007A1A8 and waits for each; Quest 64 twin dma_write (Rainchus dump.toml), same code

(value, buf, flags): writes value's decimal digits (0..9 codes) to buf and a 0xFF terminator; flag 2 = 5 digits, 4 = 2 digits, else as many as needed; flag 1 turns leading zeros into ' '; returns the digit count; Quest 64 twin count_digits (Rainchus)
